effects.label: Ability Inversion
effects.duration: until the end of its next turn

system.description:
ALTERATION SAVE

Tradition arcane, ethereal; Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal); Range 60 feet; Targets 1 creature; Saving Throw Will; Duration varies

You force the creature to cope with their own shortcomings. The targets highest and lowest ability score (casters choice for any ties) are switched for an amount of time based upon the result of their saving throw.

Critical The target is unaffected.

Success The target is affected until the end of their next turn.

Failure The target is affected for 1 minute.

Fumble The target is affected for 1 hour.

Automated: the target saves Will against your spell save DC. On a Success or Partial its highest and lowest ability scores are switched until the end of its next turn, on a Failure for 1 minute, on a Fumble or Blunder for 1 hour; a Critical leaves it unaffected. The totals switch (base and bonuses together, B8-1), so everything they feed follows, and a bonus it gains afterwards adds on top. When two scores tie for highest or lowest you are asked which.
